answer_1.quote: We seek to generate grounded summaries from podcast transcripts ... The abstracts help users quickly decide if they will listen to the podcasts ...
answer_1.outputs: grounded abstractive summaries tethered to transcript chunks

answer_2.quote: We report results on the standard test set ... The metrics include ROUGE variants ... we also experiment with recently developed metrics: BertScore and BLEURT ...

answer_4.quote: We follow the TREC guidelines to ask human evaluators to assign each summary to one of the four grades ... An assessor quickly skimmed the episode, and made judgments for each summary of the episode ...
answer_4.guideline: 8 yes/no questions (Q1–Q8) covering names, additional info, main topics, format, title context, redundancy, English quality, start/end points
